Each equilateral triangle has perimeter 21 inches, so its side length is 21 ÷ 3 = 7 inches.

The six triangles meet at the center of the hexagon, and each triangle's side equals the hexagon's side length. So the hexagon's side is 7 inches.

The perimeter of the hexagon is 6 × 7 = 42 inches.
